subject: reasoning
question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the letter-cluster that is different.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a08c777a36f898d492c29ef3a13c1a9aad5b988568e613e5a9282d9466dd8871.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 
• **CXTP → C - 5 = X; X - 4 = T; T - 4 = P**
 
• RMHC → R - 5 = M; M - 5 = H; H - 5 = C
 
• TOJE → T - 5 = O; O - 5 = J; J - 5 = E
 
• NIDY → N - 5 = I; I - 5 = D; D - 5 = Y

Hence, '**CXTP**' is the correct answer.
